title: Telehealth Consultations Now Available
excerpt: Can't make it in person? Our GPs now offer convenient telehealth video consultations for existing patients from the comfort of your home.
body: We understand that sometimes getting to the clinic isn't possible — whether due to work commitments, caring responsibilities, or feeling unwell. That's why we now offer telehealth video consultations for existing patients. Telehealth is available for a range of non-urgent health concerns, follow-up consultations, mental health support, and prescription renewals. To book a telehealth appointment, simply select 'Telehealth' when booking via HotDoc or call us on (08) 9275 7755. Please note: Medicare rebates for telehealth apply when you have attended our clinic face-to-face within the last 12 months.
